=== For Beginners (>200k) ===
You just spawned in with zero dollars to your name in spawn. /rtp to get started. Here is the ideal start to DonutSMP:

* Get wood and stone tools (/rtp again if there is no wood nearby)
* Start mining logs and crafting them into barrels which sell for 10-20k each, BUT check them FIRST on /ah barrels and make sure to list them below the lowest price (e.g. if barrels are 10k, sell them for 9.99k)
* If barrel prices are below 10k, then craft crafting tables which list for 5-10k, then boats, buttons and pressure plates. If none of these methods yield 10k+ per item, you can sell individual stacks of wood for 20-100k. ALWAYS list below the lowest price.

TIP: Instead of manually listing each item, you can type in '''/ah sell (desired price)''' to be more efficent.

=== For People 200k-1m ===

* When you get 200k, you should make an order (/order) for four stacks of sand and gunpowder. Search up the individual items, and set the /orders setting to '''most money per item'''. However, unlike for the auction house, make sure your offer is the highest rather than the lowest, so make it a dollar or even a cent higher than the existing top offers. After everything is delivered, craft the materials into TNT, which sells for 100k-200k for each stack.
* OR craft a flint and steel and RTP till you find a beach or a desert, and start blowing up the sand. /order to deliver the sand, again searching for the most money per item.
* Repeat till you gain a million dollars!

=== For People 1m-20m ===

* Now that you are a millionare, its time to make a permanent base.
* RTP again until you're next to an ocean.
* Buy a boat and swim into the ocean. (best to bring cows with you if you have infinite time)
* Wait till you're in the middle of the ocean, then dig down to Y -50 to -55 to make your new home!
* Buy bookshelves, an enchantment table and a grindstone.
* If you don't have diamonds, order them.
* Enchant diamond pickaxes and helmets.
* Repeat till you're at 10m!
* Mass order protection IV books, unbreaking 3 books and mending books
* Enchant helmets now - its far more efficent
* Repeat until you're at 20m

=== For People 20m-300m ===

* Buy a trident and enchant it with unbreaking 3, mending, impaling 5 and riptide
* Sell it for 1m more then you bought it from
* Repeat until you're at 50m
* Use RavvixSMP's tutorial on a [[Dried Kelp Farm|kelp farm]] (current meta)
* Continue enchanting
* Repeat until you're at 300m

=== For People 300m-1b ===

* Start auction flipping elytras
* Dismantle enchant system
* Build more [[Dried Kelp Farm|kelp farm]] modules
* Repeat until you're at 500m
* Start buying long term stuff - netherite ingots, enchanted golden apples, gilded blackstone, dragon heads.....
* Keep ah flipping elytras
* Keep afking the [[Dried Kelp Farm|kelp farm]]
* Repeat until you're at 1b

* /order a massive amount of said item and sell it all (e.g. amethyst)
* Start maxing out other sell multis
* Order massive amounts of elytras and list them on /ah
* Abuse the sell multi by ordering billions worth of underrated materials and /selling them
